entryEvidenceSpec.signalBar: 12H candle opening at entryMs minus 12 hours; values use its completed close
entryEvidenceSpec.rails: weekly 1.618 bands from 24 observed Monday H1 bars
entryEvidenceSpec.benchmark30d: exactly 60 consecutive 12H intervals, signal close divided by close 60 intervals earlier minus one; missing intervals yield null
entryEvidenceSpec.twoR: entryPrice + 2 * (entryPrice - fixedStopPrice); checked against tp_r=2 source exit when its target was hit
entryEvidenceSpec.directionValidation: EMA direction, signal close inside the rails, side-specific wick crossing, and stop-to-rail relation
